info.title: Partner S2S API
info.description:
Server-to-Server API for automated partner integrations with digital goods distribution platform.

## Authentication

All requests require Bearer token:
```
Authorization: Bearer {your-s2s-token}
```

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description:
Outgoing webhooks sent to your server when order statuses change.

## Setup

Configure your webhook URL in partner settings. The system will send
HTTP POST requests to that URL on order events.

## Signature Verification

Every webhook request includes two headers for authenticity verification:

- `X-Timestamp` — Unix timestamp (seconds)
- `X-Signature` — HMAC-SHA256 signature

**Signature calculation:**
```
message   = timestamp + event + idempotency_key
signature = HMAC-SHA256(message, partner_secret)
```

Where `event` and `idempotency_key` are top-level fields from the webhook JSON body.
Timestamp tolerance is ±5 minutes.

## Idempotency

Each webhook includes a unique `idempotency_key` (UUID). Use it to safely
handle duplicate deliveries — the same event may be retried up to 3 times
with exponential backoff (10s, 100s) if your server doesn't return HTTP 2xx.

## Response Requirements

Your endpoint must return HTTP **2xx** within **10 seconds**.
Non-2xx responses or timeouts are treated as failures and trigger retries.

post.description:
Create new order. Requires HMAC-SHA256 signature for S2S authentication.

## Authentication Requirements

- ✅ `X-Timestamp` header is **required**
- ✅ `X-Signature` header is **required**
- ✅ `Authorization: Bearer {s2s_token}` is **required**


## Signature Calculation

```
message   = timestamp + sku_id + external_id
signature = HMAC-SHA256(message, partner_secret)
```

Where `timestamp` is the value from `X-Timestamp` header (Unix integer),
`sku_id` is `item.sku_id` from request body, `external_id` is `external_id` from request body.

**Example:**
```
timestamp   = "1768478058"
sku_id      = "019bc0dd-8562-7173-afd9-a5cc534fafb7"
external_id = "ORD-12345"
message     = "1768478058019bc0dd-8562-7173-afd9-a5cc534fafb7ORD-12345"
signature   = hmac_sha256(message, partner_secret)
```

## Important Notes

- **Timestamp tolerance**: ±5 minutes from server time
- **Secret location**: Get `partner_secret` from your partner settings (not the API token!)
- **external_id uniqueness**: Must be unique across all your orders
- **Balance check**: Ensure sufficient balance (including overdraft if enabled)

- `custom`: Customer specifies denomination/amount at order time

Order.description: Order with items and delivery data

status.description:
- `created`: Order accepted, processing started
- `processing`: Order is being fulfilled
- `completed`: All items delivered successfully
- `failed`: Order failed completely
- `cancelled`: Order was cancelled
- `partially_completed`: Some items delivered, some failed

amount.description:
**Custom denomination only**: Customer-specified amount.
For fixed-price products, this field is null.

delivery_data.description:
Delivery codes/credentials (available when status=completed).
Array of objects with product-specific structure.

RequiredField.description:
Required field definition with validation rules.
Used for all fields needed when creating an order (system fields like quantity/amount and custom fields like phone/email).

type.description:
Transaction type:
- topup: Balance top-up (credit)
- charge: Order payment (debit)
- refund: Order refund (credit)
- adjustment: Manual balance adjustment

amount.description: Transaction amount (positive for credits, negative for debits)

payment_method.description: Payment method (only for topup/refund, null for charges)

EsimStatus.description: eSIM status and data balance information

qr_code.description: QR code for eSIM installation (LPA format)

universal_link.description: Universal link for eSIM installation (alternative to QR)

can_renew.description: Whether eSIM can be recharged with new packages

last_bundle.description: Name of the last activated bundle

coverage.description: Countries and networks covered by this eSIM

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred

idempotency_key.description: Unique key for this delivery — use to safely deduplicate retries

external_id.description: Your order identifier provided at creation

status.description:
Terminal order status:
- `completed` — all items delivered successfully
- `failed` — all items failed
- `partially_completed` — some items delivered, some failed

total_amount.description: Total charged amount (0 for fully failed orders)

completed_at.description: Timestamp when processing finished (present for terminal statuses)

delivery_data.description:
Delivery codes — present only for completed items.
Structure depends on product type:

**Voucher / Gift Card:**
```json
{ "pin": "ABCD-EFGH", "serial_number": "...", "expiration_date": "2027-01-15" }
```

**eSIM:**
```json
{ "iccid": "...", "qr_code_text": "LPA:1$...", "smdp_address": "...", "matching_id": "...", "status": "released", "total_bundles": 1, "can_renew": true }
```

error_message.description: Failure reason — present only for failed items
